title: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009
full_text: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 वजने आणि मापे ह्यांचे मानक स्थापित करणे व त्यांची अंमलबजावणी करणे. वजने, मापे आणि इतर वस्तू ज्या वजन, माप किंवा संख्येनुसार विकल्या जातात किंवा वितरित केल्या जातात , त्यांच्यामधील व्यापार आणि वाणिज्य नियंत्रित करणे आणि ह्या संबंधित किंवा अनुषंगिक बाबींसाठी हा अधिनियम आहे. Long Title: An Act to establish and enforce standards of weights and measures, regulate trade and commerce in weights, measures and other goods which are sold or distributed by weight, measure or number and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Food ,Civil supplies and consumer protection Department Enforcement Date: 01-03-2011 Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Notification: 1st March, 2011, vide notification No. S.O. 1(E), dated 31st December, 2010, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Sec. 3(ii). Existing Director, Controller and legal metrology officer not to be affected by the new qualification to be prescribed. Section 57. Repeal of the Standards of Weights and Measures Act, 1976 and Standards of Weights and Measures (Enforcement) Act, 1985.
